statement: Pinned SDL Xbox One HIDAPI driver first tries to parse a Linux-supplied HID report descriptor and retains it only when expected axes and a 12- or 15-button field exist. When retained, SDL decodes by descriptor usages; only when no accepted descriptor is available and the device is Bluetooth does it take the older hard-coded Bluetooth report-ID dispatcher. SDL selection also depends on Xbox-type identification and HIDAPI configuration.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:355-475, 714-980, 1942-2012; this adds the parser-versus-fallback distinction rather than duplicating existing report-role claims.
